international.title: Graham Thorpe’s widow takes legal action against NHS trust after inquest
international.summary: Former England Test cricketer was diagnosed with anxiety and depression before he took his own life in 2024 The wife of Graham Thorpe, the former England cricketer who took his own life, has started legal proceedings against an NHS trust after an inquest identified “failings” in his mental health care. Thorpe died aged 55 in August 2024 in Surrey. His wife, Amanda, has lodged a personal injury claim at the high court against Surrey and Borders Partnership NHS foundation trust which was involved in his care, the Telegraph reported.
